children: Public disclosure of inside information according to article 17 MAR Kahl am Main (pta/21.10.2026/19:35) - Disclosure of Inside Information pursuant to Article 17 MAR SINGULUS TECHNOLOGIES Takes Out Loan to Repay Liabilities to Triumph. Sale of Triumph Shares to German Investor Completed Kahl am Main, 21 October 2026 SINGULUS TECHNOLOGIES today secured a subordinated secured loan of approximately EUR 22.75 million. The lender is the same technology company, which had already provided financing in March 2026. This new subordinated loan is intended to repay all outstanding liabilities to Triumph Science and Technology Group Co., Ltd., China ("Triumph") and its affiliates. These liabilities stemmed from loans and advance payments received for projects and are now being repaid, so they no longer give rise to delivery obligations. In this context, Triumph transfers its approximately 16.75% stake in SINGULUS TECHNOLOGIES to a German investor. Following the sale of the shares, Mr. Denan Chu, who represents Triumph as the company's largest shareholder on the Supervisory Board, will resign from his position effective immediately. A decision on the appointment of the fourth Supervisory Board member will be made shortly.
